snippet.title: Counting Sheep - Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME No Commentary
snippet.description:
"Last year I lost my life, I’m still alive, but that’s to say that after the diagnosis there was no more living left.”

Separated from her new born baby, a homebound woman begins to notice odd discrepancies in both the population count and the caretaker of her only child.
